Catalog/Application/Transaction/Control/Effect codecs are linked, not mocked.

test friend, private-state reinterpretation, fake signature or ready-bit bypass.

structural storage with DecodedUnauthenticated, never installation authority.

copied metadata are explicitly bounded SYNTHETIC ports. Positive tiny markers
are not authenticated original deployment, Event/GM/S3/PeerProof, setup/origin-key
provisioning or F5a authorization. All such positive flags default closed.
The test scalar1 is public synthetic material; CNG or PSA performs real ECDSA.
Production missing-original policies remain closed and cannot use these markers.
No actual device, RTOS/SMP serialization, radio, actuator, sensor or power-loss
behavior is established. Handler Returned is never physical observation.

The real journal uses the independent existing session/durable NOR model from
rules-bundle-review/Store.h. A failed session is discarded, a NEW Session reads
only the model's durable image, and the actual low-level and semantic recovery
APIs run. This qualifies software under that explicit host persistence model;
it is not a real backend's flash/cache/durability guarantee. No header reset,
erase, partition resize, implicit initialize-on-corruption or rollback is used.

## Actually executed runtime cases

- Original -> late replacement and replacement -> late original: exactly one
  own solved Subject, stable shared group latch, emitted T1/T2 and intent.
  First ordinary admission is explicitly Committed with its actual input Fact
  and own Subject/latch binding before any duplicate assertion.
- Real source-compiled false guard commits NoRelease without T2/latch/intent;
  later actual original succeeds, while old status/Confirm remains NoRelease.
- Same operation/input/request returns original Final metadata without write;
  changed input/kind/request conflicts. Same Fact under a NEW operation and a
  DIFFERENT correlation digest explicitly names originalApplication and its
  original revision/index/Factrange, without new receipt, source/signing call,
  lease or write. Control/reserved Claim/other App identity collisions and same
  FactID with changed digest/binding conflict. Cold recovery behaves identically.
- Actual Claim physically read before one handler handoff. Result uncertainty
  keeps Held RESULT inventory, not Claim/Empty. New Owner and backend session
  recover without current sources; actual RestoreStopped Control intervenes
  before durable Unknown settlement. Result retains ORIGINAL ClaimFence/Boot
  despite new clock boot/control fence; second cold recovery never redelivers.
- Original proof buffers are destroyed and today's sources closed before
  successful full historical reconstruction. Later physically intact but
  semantically unsupported record rejects whole replay: no prefix committed
  status, duplicate submit or outbox publication.
- Revoked authority, expired absolute Confirm TTL and expensive source callback
  advancing time before Final publish no progress/fact/outbox/handler and do not
  rewrite accepted Confirm identity/digest/deadline.
- Missing Control evidence and distinct defaultUnavailable live preflight close
  BEFORE first catalog write. Missing original plan source supplies no unsigned
  fallback; a healthy subsequent actual original input still works.
- Outbox capacity exhaustion before reservation consumes no physical record,
  lease or history. Restored capacity retries the SAME accepted operation.
  ManualOwner intentionally keeps Confirming for its internally Deferred Tx.
- Claim eligibility failure is prewrite only with actual physical phase absent;
  later valid Claim -> handler -> Returned Result and duplicate cause one handoff.
- Actual application-write budgets0/1/20 produce Unknown without progress or
  live-cache retry/header reset. Genuine zero-byte new session can recover;
  actually partial durable records stay closed and unchanged. No automatic
  erasure or fake successful semantic reopen is used for corrupt partial data.
